integrity: The source vertex structure is independently reconstructed from the graphical minimal-matroid realization. Uniqueness and block symmetry reduce the minimum-enclosing-ball problem to one scalar parameter, for which the two orbit distances are explicit quadratics. The phase transition follows from their crossing relative to the exchange-orbit quadratic minimum; positive contact barycenters give global minimality certificates.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the standard indicator-vector realization of the minimal connected matroid base polytope. It determines the unique minimum enclosing Euclidean ball and contact phase, not the inradius or extremal ellipsoids, and the formulas are not affine invariants.
title: Minimal-matroid base polytopes have a one-exception minimum-sphere transition
